tools.name: search_unified_pool
tools.description: Search across auctions, expired, backorder, and buy_now domain pools aggregated from Nameholder, Sedo, Namecheap, Dynadot, Porkbun, NameSilo, GoDaddy, DropCatch, and Fragment.

tools.name: check_domain_live
tools.description: Run a live RDAP availability, lifecycle, and expiration check for a domain.

tools.name: enrich_domain_seo
tools.description: Compute Wayback Machine CDX history sparkline, snapshot count, parking/redirect signals, Spam Score, Domain Authority, Backlinks estimate, and composite Karma Score.

tools.name: valuate_brand
tools.description: Estimate market value in EUR (min/median/max and tier AAA-C) for a domain or handle.

tools.name: create_batch_check_task
tools.description: Submit a batch of up to 50 domains for availability, SEO enrichment, and brand valuation (enforces daily UTC quota).

tools.name: list_saved_filters
tools.description: List saved search filters and alert subscriptions.

tools.name: create_saved_filter_alert
tools.description: Create a saved search filter over the unified pool and enable automated Inbox, Telegram, and Webhook alerts.

tools.name: get_drop_radar
tools.description: Fetch top ranked dropping domains in the next 24h-72h ordered by urgency and valuation.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_saved_filter_alert · Public sink: create_batch_check_task, create_saved_filter_alert · Destructive: check_domain_live, get_drop_radar.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_saved_filter_alert · Public sink: create_batch_check_task, create_saved_filter_alert · Destructive: check_domain_live, get_drop_radar

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
